verses.ar: «ٱلْيَوْمَ أَيْضًا شَكْوَايَ تَمَرُّدٌ. ضَرْبَتِي أَثْقَلُ مِنْ تَنَهُّدِي.
verses.kjv: Even to day [is] my complaint bitter: my stroke is heavier than my groaning.
verses.web: “Even today my complaint is rebellious. His hand is heavy in spite of my groaning.

verses.ar: مَنْ يُعْطِينِي أَنْ أَجِدَهُ، فَآتِيَ إِلَى كُرْسِيِّهِ،
verses.kjv: Oh that I knew where I might find him! [that] I might come [even] to his seat!
verses.web: Oh that I knew where I might find him! That I might come even to his seat!

verses.ar: أُحْسِنُ ٱلدَّعْوَى أَمَامَهُ، وَأَمْلَأُ فَمِي حُجَجًا،
verses.kjv: I would order [my] cause before him, and fill my mouth with arguments.
verses.web: I would set my cause in order before him, and fill my mouth with arguments.

verses.ar: فَأَعْرِفُ ٱلْأَقْوَالَ ٱلَّتِي بِهَا يُجِيبُنِي، وَأَفْهَمُ مَا يَقُولُهُ لِي؟
verses.kjv: I would know the words [which] he would answer me, and understand what he would say unto me.
verses.web: I would know the words which he would answer me, and understand what he would tell me.

verses.ar: أَبِكَثْرَةِ قُوَّةٍ يُخَاصِمُنِي؟ كَّلَّا! وَلَكِنَّهُ كَانَ يَنْتَبِهُ إِلَيَّ.
verses.kjv: Will he plead against me with [his] great power? No; but he would put [strength] in me.
verses.web: Would he contend with me in the greatness of his power? No, but he would listen to me.

verses.ar: هُنَالِكَ كَانَ يُحَاجُّهُ ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمُ، وَكُنْتُ أَنْجُو إِلَى ٱلْأَبَدِ مِنْ قَاضِيَّ.
verses.kjv: There the righteous might dispute with him; so should I be delivered for ever from my judge.
verses.web: There the upright might reason with him, so I should be delivered forever from my judge.

verses.ar: هَأَنَذَا أَذْهَبُ شَرْقًا فَلَيْسَ هُوَ هُنَاكَ، وَغَرْبًا فَلَا أَشْعُرُ بِهِ.
verses.kjv: Behold, I go forward, but he [is] not [there;] and backward, but I cannot perceive him:
verses.web: “If I go east, he is not there. If I go west, I can’t find him.

verses.ar: شِمَالًا حَيْثُ عَمَلُهُ فَلَا أَنْظُرُهُ. يَتَعَطَّفُ ٱلْجَنُوبَ فَلَا أَرَاهُ.
verses.kjv: On the left hand, where he doth work, but I cannot behold [him:] he hideth himself on the right hand, that I cannot see [him:]
verses.web: He works to the north, but I can’t see him. He turns south, but I can’t catch a glimpse of him.

verses.ar: «لِأَنَّهُ يَعْرِفُ طَرِيقِي. إِذَا جَرَّبَنِي أَخْرُجُ كَٱلذَّهَبِ.
verses.kjv: But he knoweth the way that I take: [when] he hath tried me, I shall come forth as gold.
verses.web: But he knows the way that I take. When he has tried me, I will come out like gold.

verses.ar: بِخَطَوَاتِهِ ٱسْتَمْسَكَتْ رِجْلِي. حَفِظْتُ طَرِيقَهُ وَلَمْ أَحِدْ.
verses.kjv: My foot hath held his steps, his way have I kept, and not declined.
verses.web: My foot has held fast to his steps. I have kept his way, and not turned away.

verses.ar: مِنْ وَصِيَّةِ شَفَتَيْهِ لَمْ أَبْرَحْ. أَكْثَرَ مِنْ فَرِيضَتِي ذَخَرْتُ كَلَامَ فِيهِ.
verses.kjv: Neither have I gone back from the commandment of his lips; I have esteemed the words of his mouth more than my necessary [food].
verses.web: I haven’t gone back from the commandment of his lips. I have treasured up the words of his mouth more than my necessary food.

verses.ar: أَمَّا هُوَ فَوَحْدَهُ، فَمَنْ يَرُدُّهُ؟ وَنَفْسُهُ تَشْتَهِي فَيَفْعَلُ.
verses.kjv: But he [is] in one [mind], and who can turn him? and [what] his soul desireth, even [that] he doeth.
verses.web: But he stands alone, and who can oppose him? What his soul desires, even that he does.

verses.ar: لِأَنَّهُ يُتَمِّمُ ٱلْمَفْرُوضَ عَلَيَّ، وَكَثِيرٌ مِثْلُ هَذِهِ عِنْدَهُ.
verses.kjv: For he performeth [the thing that is] appointed for me: and many such [things are] with him.
verses.web: For he performs that which is appointed for me. Many such things are with him.

verses.ar: مِنْ أَجْلِ ذَلِكَ أَرْتَاعُ قُدَّامَهُ. أَتَأَمَّلُ فَأَرْتَعِبُ مِنْهُ.
verses.kjv: Therefore am I troubled at his presence: when I consider, I am afraid of him.
verses.web: Therefore I am terrified at his presence. When I consider, I am afraid of him.

verses.ar: لِأَنَّ ٱللهَ قَدْ أَضْعَفَ قَلْبِي، وَٱلْقَدِيرَ رَوَّعَنِي.
verses.kjv: For God maketh my heart soft, and the Almighty troubleth me:
verses.web: For God has made my heart faint. The Almighty has terrified me.

verses.ar: لِأَنِّي لَمْ أُقْطَعْ قَبْلَ ٱلظَّلَامِ، وَمِنْ وَجْهِي لَمْ يُغَطِّ ٱلدُّجَى.
verses.kjv: Because I was not cut off before the darkness, [neither] hath he covered the darkness from my face.
verses.web: Because I was not cut off before the darkness, neither did he cover the thick darkness from my face.
